pages.title: Unusual Properties
pages.text: At first glance, $(item)Draconium$() can not only transmit resonance, but also store energy. If it can be processed into equipment or tools, it should have considerable practical value.$(br2)First, however, I need to find a way to stabilize the transmission of resonance. Its later applications can wait.

pages.title: Unstable Energy
pages.text: Energy storage and transmission fluctuate considerably between environments. Merely recording an instrument reading is not useful; I have to check whether energy is actually flowing.$(br2)This energy seems easy to convert into electricity or send into other compatible systems. More testing is needed.
